messages:
alex w: handing primary to jamie c for the evening shift. Ongoing issue: TOKENSTORE P99 spike in eu-west, customers seeing 5xx/502 on embeddings and regen endpoints. Current customer impact: Acme AI regen failures (~12% of their requests). Primary/secondary: jamie c (primary), priya r (secondary). Short summary of current state and actions below.

incident-bot: ALERT INC-2026-482 TOKENSTORE_P99 eu-west > 1200ms (5m) :rotating_light: https://alerts.internal/INC-2026-482

jamie c: taking primary. thanks alex. quick question — what mitigations are already in flight? any runbook steps executed?

alex w: done so far:
- scaled token-store deployment (eu-west) replicas 6 -> 12
- enabled `kv-prefetch` feature-toggle (v2.1) to reduce cold misses
- applied temporary rate-shed on /v1/embeddings (50%) to protect tokenstore
Telemetry: error rate dropped from ~18% -> ~9% in last 7m but p99 still elevated (~1.2s).
CLI snippets used:```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/token-store --replicas=12 -l region=eu-west
curl -u ops-api-token: -X POST https://ops-api.internal/feature-toggle -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"feature":"kv-prefetch","on":true}'
```

priya r: I'm on secondary for the next 6h. note: APAC nights currently uncovered (coverage gap). If this regresses overnight we should consider calling in infra contractors or enabling dedicated fallback. Support ticket: ACME #2234 is open and support has been pinged.

sven l: small additional mitigation if p99 doesn't fall: switch cache fallback to read-only for non-critical requests to reduce write pressure. Command endpoint to toggle:```
POST /ops/cache/fallback?mode=ro
``` Expect ~10-15% reduction in evictions, but some stale reads for a short window.

jamie c: ack. I'll monitor grafana p99 panels and logs. My immediate checklist: monitor p99 every 5m (https://grafana.internal/d/abc/tokenstore-euw), check eviction rates and queue depth, validate ACME regen retry behavior. If p99 > 2s or errors > 15% escalate to infra.

alex w: escalation rules for clarity:
- Condition A: customer-impacted errors > 30% OR p99 > 2s for 10m -> page infra-oncall and run dedicated fallback (playbook link).
- Condition B: sustained memory/eviction spike despite scale -> open hotfix (hot-patch kernel param) and involve runtime-team.
Runbooks: https://playbooks.internal/runbooks/tokenstore-fallback and https://playbooks.internal/runbooks/tokenstore-evictions

priya r: noted. I've already posted a targeted status to support and told Acme we're mitigating, no data loss expected. Support ref: #2234. I'll follow up if we need to widen customer comms.

sven l: if jamie needs me I can join in ~30m to do a hotfix rollout (will require a short 30s read-only blip).

jamie c: handing-accepted. I'll post updates to this thread every 15m or whenever something material changes. Current plan for first 30m: watch p99, review s3 logs for errors, verify scale holds.

alex w: couple of operational notes: logs are in s3 path s3://redwood-logs/euw/tokenstore/2026-03-15/3612345678/ — grep for "eviction" and "ERR_REGEN". Also dashboard snapshots saved in the incident doc.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED INC-2026-482 -> mitigations applied (scale + toggle + rate-shed). Next review in 15m.

jamie c: logging note: I'm tailing logs and watching agent traces. Quick commands I run: `redis-cli -h tokenstore-eu --latency` and `curl https://telemetry.internal/query?p=tokenstore.p99` — will paste outputs if something spikes.

alex w: one more: coverage gap reminder — APAC is not staffed tonight. If this spreads to apac we should consider the cold-start warmup play (warm-primaries in apac) or enable global-fallback routing. That requires infra assist.

priya r: I'll update the oncall rota and flag APAC gap on the escalation doc.

jamie c: taking it from here. Primary: jamie c. Secondary: priya r. Support escalation: ACME #2234. Watchlist: evictions, queue-depth, customer regen errors. I'll update every 15m. :thumbsup:

sven l: standing by for hotfix.

alex w: handing over — good luck team.

jamie c: closing handoff — acknowledged. this thread will be the single source of truth for tonight's mitigation steps and updates.
